items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Pops As Fed Rate-Hike Odds Fall; Sezzle Loses Its Sizzle (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite was a standout among major indexes Friday, with technology stocks climbing after U.S. job losses cut the odds of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates.  On the stock market today, financial name Sezzle plummeted while a medical tests maker popped following earnings reports.  The Nasdaq composite forged ahead 1.1%.

items.title: DUST Drops 13% as Gold Miners Rally Hard
items.summary: Gold miners are tearing higher on blowout earnings and record-near gold prices, leaving one popular inverse fund in freefall and raising serious questions about what compounding decay does to traders caught on the wrong side of a trend.
